projects.title: Townhouse bathroom renovation

projects.text: Removal of old finishes, wall and floor preparation, utility adjustments, and all finishing work.
projects.alt: Interior space during renovation with exposed concrete walls

projects.title: Interior staircase refurbishment
projects.text: New oak treads, a glass balustrade, and precise transitions to the existing floor finishes.

mechanics.title: Tuning & mechanics
mechanics.subtitle: Reliable diagnostics, repairs, and tuning for cars, tractors, and work machines.

projects.title: Electronic fault diagnostics
projects.text: Testing power circuits, sensors, and stored fault codes to confirm the cause before replacing parts.
projects.alt: Mechanic's hands diagnosing a car electrical system
projects.result: A targeted repair without unnecessary component replacement.

projects.title: Delivery van service and optimization
projects.text: Preventive engine service, intake inspection, and response tuning for demanding daily delivery routes.
projects.alt: Mechanic inspecting a car engine with a tool
projects.result: Smoother running and more predictable response under load.

projects.title: Tractor optimization for hillside work
projects.text: Baseline measurements, a safe engine-control adjustment, and testing under realistic working load.
projects.alt: Green tractor with a sprayer working in a field
projects.result: More consistent torque and fewer gear changes during heavy work.

mechanics.contact: For service or tuning, send machine/vehicle model and issue description.

footer.description: BMM Cesar is a family team of three brothers combining construction, mechanics, and software into practical project delivery.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: BMM Cesar is built by three brothers with different skills and one shared standard: quality execution.
about.missionText: We are not trying to be a generic agency. We combine field work, machine knowledge, and digital delivery in one team.
about.storyText: Real projects often overlap: renovation, machine reliability, and software visibility. Our model reflects that reality.
about.teamText: We are still in an early growth phase, so we stay realistic, responsive, and direct in communication.
